subject: Renewal + capacity increase: invoicing, PO and tax forms
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@stratalink.io>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@stratalink.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — invoicing and PO guidance

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and ask so procurement has what they need to issue the PO: we agreed to renew Stratalink’s commitment and increase capacity from the current 2 reserved units to 6 (steady-state) for Q4 onwards — the pricing sheet I attached in the demo reflects the applied volume credit.

To complete the contract and get billing live we need: 
- A PO referencing deal SL-2027-044 (total annual commitment: $342,000)
- Billing contact for invoice delivery (email + AP contact)
- Any required tax docs for your payor entity (we typically receive a W-9 for US entities)
- Confirmation on net terms (we proposed net45 in the term sheet; happy to discuss)

If procurement can send a draft PO and billing email, Naomi (cc’d) from our finance team will validate the invoice cadence and finalize the W-9. I can accept a signed PO PDF or a DocuSign link — whichever is your standard flow.

Next steps: would you be able to circulate a PO by end of day Wednesday? If not, please propose a date and I’ll coordinate internally.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: pricing_summary_stratalink_q4.pdf (PDF)
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@stratalink.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@stratalink.io>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — invoicing and PO guidance

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. A few procurement items/questions before we issue the PO: 

1) Our AP team needs the exact remit/bill-to entity name and EIN as you will show on the invoice. Is that the Redwood Inc. (US) entity?
2) We typically request net60 on renewals with public sector clients. Can Redwood confirm whether net45 is firm or if net60 is an option (we stated preference but can escalate).
3) Please attach your current W-9 (we need it to attach to the PO) and a copy of the final pricing spreadsheet that will appear on the invoice.

If you can send the W-9 and confirm remit entity by EOD, we’ll route the PO for signature next week.

Samantha Reed
Senior Procurement Manager, Stratalink
samantha.reed@stratalink.io
+1 617-555-8877

Jordan (internal): I recommend we provide the W-9 and accept net45 for this account — they’re strategic and the upside is meaningful. Marissa, can you prep the W-9 and confirm the remit name/EIN and whether finance will accept net45 vs net60? If net60 is requested, what approvals do we need?

Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity increase — invoicing and PO guidance

Hi Samantha / Tom — looping back with the items you requested. Apologies for the short delay; Naomi and I validated with finance.

Summary / answers:
- Invoice remit entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Please use this exactly on the PO/invoice.
- W-9: attached (Redwood_W9_2027.pdf).
- Net terms: we can accept net45 as documented in the term sheet. Net60 requires a credit approval and would add a 30-day payment supervision — for speed we recommend net45.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices in arrears. We will send invoice to AP (invoicing@stratalink.io) and cc your billing contact if you provide one.

Attached to this message: Stratalink_PO_20270903_signed.pdf (signed PO stub) and Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (tax form). We also uploaded the signed PO to DocuSign (link below) and pushed the agreement into the deal record.

Next steps for your team: confirm the AP email to receive invoices and we’ll mark the deal as invoicing-ready and schedule first invoice for Oct 1 (covering September usage).

If you need the PO in a different format for your procurement system, let me know and I’ll re-export.

Best,
Marissa Cole
